title: On the Sunny Side of the Street
writers: Jimmy McHugh (music, credited; some sources attribute the composition to Fats Waller), Dorothy Fields (lyrics)

evidence.note: Published in 1930 and introduced in the Broadway revue Lew Leslie's International Revue (1930), starring Harry Richman and Gertrude Lawrence.

famous_use: Louis Armstrong recorded one of the song's most famous versions.
